reviews.title: Awesome price to performance
reviews.comment: The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/C1QaHBGJWrL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/612ReBJzeZL._SY256.jpg Awesome Ram for the price, one of the cheaper sets in the market right now! 48 gbs capacity with a whopping 7200 mt/s rating, this bad boy can power through any application or games you can throw at it. I personally take advantage of the Ram capacity with streaming games and the megatrasfers helps a lot with system latency. The  ram cooling solution is sleek and aesthetic and will fit in seamlessly to any pc build. The ram is easy to install and functionality was solid. The ARGB strips on the ram kit can get very bright and displays any color of your choice very well. Great product, highly recommend these for anyone that needs a little bit more ram but don't want to commit to the full 64 gb kits.

reviews.title: Might be the best ram I've ever used!!

Don't be a fool, you don't need to pay twice as much for a "brand name" memory....this stuff works as well, or better at half the price. 5 stars!

reviews.title: great quality, price and compatibility
reviews.comment:
I bought the 6400Mhz CL32 version of this memory stick.  If you look up reviews (i read techpowerup), this seems to be the sweet spot during memory speed tests including memory in 7000Mhz-8000Mhz.  so it might not beat it but it's very close like miliseconds behind these higher speed memory modules and at a lower power usage, and price.  I bought this for AMD Expo (AM5 mobo)  but it does have XMP settings for Intel mobo's.  Another reason i bought this memory is that it uses sk hynix memory chips,  these are the same chips used in Gskill's popular memory modules that are probably some of the most compatible and used.  So that's a plus.  Also the RGB is great, looks like any other high quality memory module.  Anyways, great memory.
Update:  i tried 4 sticks and my msi motherboard was unstable.  Tried 6200 and 6000 timings and still a bit unstable.  It boots at default 4800 and rock solid but dissapointing.  Not a memory issue, its the same memory controller issue. When you go back to two sticks,  boots up solid on expo settings at 6400 cl32.  So if you have am5, get higher capacity in two sticks.
